description: Implement filename escaping for Content-Disposition headers in attachment and file stream responses. Currently, filenames containing special characters like quotes can break out of the quoted-string boundary, creating a security vulnerability. Add proper escaping to ensure filenames remain safely contained within the header.
functional_requirements: Escape backslash characters as '\\' and double quote characters as '\"' in filenames before inserting them into Content-Disposition headers
Apply escaping in both the attachment response builder and file stream response builder
Ensure the escaping follows RFC 2616 quoted-string rules for proper HTTP header formatting
Add comprehensive tests to verify that filenames with special characters are properly escaped and don't break header boundaries
